$meta.status: Working set. Contrast-verified in CI. A designer may refine or replace values; the SHAPE is fixed and code depends on it.

colour.$note: Low-chroma warm ground. The photography is the colour; the interface must not compete with a saree. Accent is lac red, used on small surfaces only — never a large field.

sunk.use: Recessed bands, editorial pull sections, sold-out card wash

surface.use: Cards, drawers, modals, sticky buy bar

muted.use: Captions, eyebrows, metadata. AA at body size, not for <14px.

disabled.use: Disabled control text only. Not AA — never carries meaning alone.

hairline.use: Default 1px separators, table rules, input borders at rest

strong.use: Active input border, focus-adjacent, selected facet chip. Darkened from the first draft to clear WCAG 1.4.11 (3:1) against bg.surface — an input border is a UI component boundary, not decoration.

lac.use: Primary CTA fill, active link underline, notify-form submit

lacQuiet.use: Selected-chip wash, notify-form band. Large-field safe because it carries no text weight of its own.

soldOut.use: Sold-out label. Deliberately the muted ink — sold out is a state, not an alarm.

contrastPairs.$note: Every pair CI verifies. `min` is the WCAG 2.2 threshold this pair must clear. Adding a colour without adding its pair here is a CI failure.

pairs.context: Input border — non-text UI component, WCAG 1.4.11

type.$note: Two families. Display serif carries product names and editorial; the UI face stays quiet. Devanagari coverage is a hard requirement — poetic_name may be set in Devanagari (build.md §2.1).

display.value: 'Source Serif 4', 'Tiro Devanagari Hindi', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
display.use: Product names, editorial headings, pull quotes
display.loading: self-hosted woff2, font-display: swap, subset latin + latin-ext + devanagari

ui.use: Navigation, buttons, facets, form labels, prices, specs

scale.$note: size / line-height / letter-spacing, per breakpoint. Values in rem; root stays 16px at every breakpoint.

display.use: Homepage hero, campaign story standfirst headline

h1.use: Product name on PDP, collection title, page title

h3.use: Editorial teaser titles, related-product group headings

h4.use: Spec tab headings, facet group headings, cart line titles

bodyLg.use: The ~90-word narrative on the PDP, editorial long-form

body.use: Default UI copy, spec values, form fields

caption.use: Image captions, dispatch lead time, shipping note
caption.constraint: Never set in ink.muted below 14px computed — see contrastPairs note.

eyebrow.use: Campaign eyebrow, weave label above product name, section kickers

price.use: PDP price, sticky buy bar. Tabular figures so 8 currencies align in the cart.

space.$note: 4px base, 11 steps. One scale serves both the editorial vertical rhythm and the commerce grid gutters.

sectionYEditorial.use: Editorial pages breathe more than commerce pages

stackLoose.use: Block to block within a section

grid.$note: Breakpoints settled in build.md §8.4 — 768 / 1024 / 1440. The competitor's 798px is a bought-theme artefact and is not inherited.

containerNarrow.use: Long-form editorial body — measure capped for readability

productGrid.note: Two-up on mobile is deliberate. One-up wastes the 2:3 frame and buries the fold.

motion.$note: Restrained. Hover-swap on product cards and menu reveals only. No scroll-jacking, no parallax — build.md §2.5.

fast.use: Hover states, focus rings, chip toggles

medium.use: Card image hover-swap, dropdown reveal, accordion

slow.use: Cart drawer, search overlay, mega-menu panel

motion.reducedMotion: All duration tokens collapse to 0ms under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce. Implemented once in globals.css, not per component.

elevation.$note: Rules and space, not shadows. This is a category convention and it is enforced: `box-shadow` other than the focus ring is a lint failure.

bounded.use: Cards, inputs, table cells, spec rows

raised.use: Sticky buy bar, announcement bar underline

overlay.use: Cart drawer, search overlay, modal — separated by a scrim, not a shadow

radius.note: Zero radius everywhere. One exception permitted: the focus ring may inherit the element's zero radius — i.e. there is no exception.

image.$note: First-class tokens. Must match photography-brief.md §2.1 exactly. Both ratios are reserved in CSS to protect CLS (build.md §6).

square.use: Gallery frames 6+, detail/zari frames, category tiles

heroMobile.use: Campaign hero mobile — separate art, never a crop of desktop

image.note: srcset must not advertise a width larger than the master. The competitor advertises 5000w against 1440–1600px masters; buyers zooming into zari hit an upscale. Cap the ladder at the true master width.
